content_sections.heading: NABFINS Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: NABFINS has announced an opportunity for the post of Customer Service Officer, Telecaller . The number of vacancies has not been specified in the details provided for this recruitment.

content_sections.heading: NABFINS Customer Service Officer Job Role
content_sections.text: The primary responsibility of a Customer Service Officer is to source customers and increase the sustainable portfolio of the branch . The CSO has to identify new business locations, source potential customers and support their addition to the branch portfolio. After disbursement, the employee is also responsible for following up with customers and collecting installments on scheduled dates.

content_sections.heading: Responsibilities
content_sections.text: The key responsibilities of a NABFINS Customer Service Officer include: Sourcing of clients. Primary verification of client credentials. Conducting Compulsory Group Training. Data entry in CRIF. Data entry in CMS. Accompanying the Branch Manager for Group Recognition Test. Accompanying CSE during pre-disbursement activities. Ensuring disbursement. Generating demand. Following up for recovery and undertaking collections. Remitting collections in the bank or banks. Reporting demand and collection details to ABM/BM. Maintaining and filing documents. Telecaller-Work From Home Responsible for calling existing and prospective customers from the provided database. Responsible for proper follow-up and maintain the conversation records. Responsible to understand customer concern, do proper analysis of customer concern to find out the reason and educate the customer.

content_sections.heading: NABFINS Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the NABFINS Customer Service Officer, Telecaller Recruitment 2026 must meet the prescribed educational, language and field mobility requirements. The minimum educational qualification is: PUC/10+2 completed. Candidates who have completed Higher Secondary or an equivalent 10+2 qualification can apply, subject to the other eligibility requirements. Applicants must have written, spoken and reading command over the local language and English . This requirement is important because the role involves regular interaction with customers, branch staff and field-level operations. Freshers are eligible to apply for the Customer Service Officer post. However, candidates with 1 to 3 years of experience in a similar job profile and sufficient exposure to field operations and the target customer population may be preferred. A valid driving licence and motorcycle are mandatory for the Customer Service Officer role. The job involves field visits, identifying new business locations, customer sourcing, collection and other branch-related field activities. Qualification : Minimum qualification – PUC/10+2 completed. Experience : Fresher’s are eligible to apply Age Limit: Maximum age limit at 30 years

content_sections.heading: NABFINS Customer Service Officer Important Dates 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should send their application before 26 August 2026 and avoid waiting until the last day.

content_sections.heading: NABFINS Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The detailed selection process has not been specified in the information provided. Candidates who submit their resume may be shortlisted by NABFINS based on eligibility, educational qualification, experience, field suitability and other requirements of the Customer Service Officer role. Shortlisted candidates should follow further instructions communicated by NABFINS regarding the next stages of recruitment.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NABFINS Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Check the NABFINS Customer Service Officer eligibility criteria. Prepare an updated resume containing educational qualification and work experience details. Ensure that your mobile number and email address are correctly mentioned in the resume. Attach the updated resume to the email. Use a clear subject line such as Application for Customer Service Officer (CSO), Telecaller-Work From Home Send the application to [email protected] . Complete the application process on or before 26 August 2026 .

faq.question: Q1. What is the post available under NABFINS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NABFINS Limited has invited applications for the post of Customer Service Officer (CSO) and Telecaller.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification required for NABFINS Customer Service Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed PUC/10+2 or equivalent qualification to apply.

faq.question: Q3. Can freshers apply for NABFINS Customer Service Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, freshers are eligible to apply. Candidates with 1 to 3 years of relevant field experience may be preferred.

faq.question: Q4. Is a driving licence required for the NABFINS CSO post?
faq.answer: Yes, a valid driving licence and motorcycle are mandatory for the Customer Service Officer field role.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NABFINS Telecaller Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Telecaller post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q6. What are the job locations for NABFINS Customer Service Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available locations include Bihar, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, and Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for NABFINS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates have to apply by sending their updated resume through email.
